'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[War in Afghanistan (2001–present)|War in Afghanistan]]
**[[Taliban insurgency]]
***[[2021 Taliban offensive]]
****The [[government of Afghanistan|government]] imposes a nighttime curfew between 10 p.m. and 4 a.m. in 31 of the country's 34 [[provinces of Afghanistan|provinces]] in an attempt to reduce both the level of violence as well as the [[surveillance]] of the [[Taliban]] and its movements. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/7/24/afghanistan-imposes-night-curfew-amid-surge-in-taliban-advance (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Boko Haram insurgency]]
**Six soldiers are killed and four more are wounded as [[Boko Haram]] militants open fire against a military base in Sagme, [[Cameroon]]. [https://amp.france24.com/en/africa/20210724-boko-haram-attack-kills-several-soldiers-in-cameroon-regional-governor-says (France 24)]

'''Arts and culture'''
*[[LGBT rights in Hungary]]
**Thousands of people join the [[pride march]] in [[Budapest]], which was also in protest of the [[Hungarian anti-LGBT law|newly passed law]] that prohibits teachings about [[homosexuality]] in schools. Organizers criticized the [[government of Hungary|government]] and said that the ruling party was making "laws to make members of the [[LGBT]]Q community outcasts in their own country". [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/thousands-join-budapest-pride-march-protest-over-new-anti-lgbt-law-2021-07-24/ (Reuters)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[Typhoon In-fa (2021)|Typhoon In-fa]]
**In the [[Philippines]], two people are killed and thousands more are evacuated from their homes after [[monsoon rains]] compounded by a tropical [[typhoon]] cause heavy flooding in [[Metro Manila]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/7/24/philippines-evacuates-thousands-as-monsoon-rains-flood-cities-pr (Al Jazeera)]
*[[2021 Henan floods]]
**Thirty-three more people are killed during the heavy floods in [[Henan]], [[China]], bringing the death toll to 58. [https://www.scmp.com/news/china/politics/article/3142360/china-floods-more-75-million-people-henan-now-affected (''South China Morning Post'')]
*Fourteen people are killed and 26 more injured during a warehouse fire in the Jingyue High-tech Industrial Development Zone in [[Changchun]], [[Jilin]] province, China. [http://www.xinhuanet.com/english/2021-07/24/c_1310083177.htm (Xinhua News Agency)]
*The death toll from the heavy floods that are affecting [[India]] since a week rise to 135 people, the majority of whom in [[Maharashtra]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/7/24/at-least-76-killed-in-india-heavy-monsoon-rains-govt (Al Jazeera)]
*A [[seaplane]] incident involving the French power grid causes a [[Power outage|blackout]] affecting more than one million users in 9 regions, mostly in [[Spain]], but also in some regions of [[Portugal]]. [https://www.elmundo.es/economia/2021/07/24/60fc347921efa0f57d8b4592.html (''El Mundo'')]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Asia]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Indonesia]]
****[[Indonesia]] reports a record 39,767 recoveries from [[COVID-19]] in the past 24 hours, thereby bringing the nationwide total of recoveries to 2.47 million.  [https://news.detik.com/berita/d-5655287/data-corona-ri-24-juli-45416-kasus-baru-rekor-39767-kasus-sembuh?tag_from=wpm_nhl_9 (detikNews)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Laos]]
****[[Laos]] reports a record 278 new cases of COVID-19 in the past 24 hours, thereby bringing the nationwide total of confirmed cases to 4,620.  [http://www.xinhuanet.com/english/asiapacific/2021-07/24/c_1310082905.htm (Xinhuanet)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Malaysia]]
****[[Malaysia]] reports a record for the second consecutive day of 15,902 new cases of COVID-19, thereby bringing the nationwide total of confirmed cases to 996,393.  [https://www.channelnewsasia.com/news/asia/covid-19-malaysia-reports-record-15-902-new-cases-15285352 (CNA)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Vietnam]]
****[[Vietnam]]'s strictest [[social distancing]] measures are imposed in [[Hanoi]] for the next 15 days under "Directive 16" which requires people to stay home except for essential reasons in order to prevent further spread of COVID-19. [https://vietnamnet.vn/en/society/hanoi-applies-stricter-social-distancing-measures-under-directive-16-759018.html (Vietnam Net)]
****Vietnam reports a record 7,978 new cases of COVID-19 in the past 24 hours, thereby bringing the nationwide total of confirmed cases to 90,934.  [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/vietnam-reports-record-7968-coronavirus-cases-saturday-2021-07-24/ (Reuters)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Africa]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Tanzania]], [[COVID-19 vaccination in Tanzania]]
****[[Tanzania]] receives its first shipment of 1 million doses of the [[Johnson & Johnson COVID-19 vaccine]] donated by the [[Government of the United States|U.S. government]]. [https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2021-07-24/tanzania-receives-1st-batch-of-covid-19-vaccines (Bloomberg)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Tunisia]]
****[[Tunisia]] reports a record 799 deaths from COVID-19 in the past 24 hours, thereby bringing the nationwide death toll to 18,369. [https://www.aa.com.tr/en/latest-on-coronavirus-outbreak/tunisia-records-highest-daily-deaths-from-coronavirus/2312972 (Anadolu Agency)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Colombia]]
***[[Colombia]] reports its first case of the [[SARS-CoV-2 Delta variant]] in an international traveller who arrived in [[Cali]] from the [[United States]]. [https://cnnespanol.cnn.com/2021/07/24/detectan-primer-caso-de-la-variante-delta-en-colombia-orix/ (CNN Español)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in New Zealand]], [[Travel restrictions related to the COVID-19 pandemic]]
***[[New Zealand]] suspends its quarantine-free travel bubble with [[Australia]] for at least eight weeks amid an increase in the number of COVID-19 cases caused by the SARS-CoV-2 Delta variant. However, there will be managed return flights for the next seven days for New Zealand citizens who wish to return home. [https://www.smh.com.au/world/oceania/come-home-new-zealand-suspends-trans-tasman-bubble-for-two-months-20210723-p58cc3.html (''The Sydney Morning Herald'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United Kingdom]]
***Former ''[[Good Morning Britain (2014 TV programme)|Good Morning Britain]]'' host [[Piers Morgan]] says that he tested positive for COVID-19 during the [[UEFA Euro 2020 Final]]. [https://www.plymouthherald.co.uk/news/celebs-tv/double-jabbed-piers-morgan-thinks-5695727 (''Plymouth Herald'')]
*[[Climate change in Australia]]
**The [[World Heritage Committee]] rejects calls from [[UNESCO]] to list the [[Great Barrier Reef]] as a [[World Heritage Site]] "in danger" due to the effects of [[Climate change|anthropogenic climate change]] and [[ocean acidification]], in line with [[scientific consensus]] on the Reef's health. Australia lobbied a number of oil-rich countries, including [[Russia]] and [[Saudi Arabia]], to reject the proposal. [https://www.theguardian.com/environment/2021/jul/23/world-heritage-committee-agrees-not-to-place-great-barrier-reef-on-in-danger-list (''The Guardian'')]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[Protests over responses to the COVID-19 pandemic]]
**Protests take place across Europe and Australia in response to COVID-19 restrictions and vaccination requirements for healthcare workers. [https://www.independent.co.uk/news/uk/home-news/lockdown-protests-london-covid-vaccine-b1889966.html (''The Independent'')]
*[[2021 Iranian protests]]
**Protests continue to occur in Iran for the tenth consecutive day as people in [[Tabriz]] also take to the streets. [https://iranintl.com/en/iran/demonstrators-irans-tabriz-show-support-protests-khuzestan (Iran International)]

'''Sports'''
*[[Impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on sports]], [[2021 NFL season]]
**The [[National Football League]] announces that players not adhering to COVID-19 restrictions will be subjected to a fine of [[United States dollar|$]]14,650 during the season. [https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/31875274/nfl-fine-unvaccinated-players-14650-violation-covid-19-protocol (ESPN)]
*[[2020 Summer Olympics]]
**[[Yang Qian (sport shooter)|Yang Qian]] of [[China at the 2020 Summer Olympics|China]]'s [[ISSF 10 meter air rifle|women's 10-meter rifle team]] wins the first [[Olympic medal|gold medal]] of this year's Olympics. [https://www.reuters.com/lifestyle/sports/shooting-chinas-yang-wins-first-gold-medal-tokyo-olympics-2021-07-24/ (Reuters)]
